title: 天皇賞（秋）の後に・限界の先へ

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: The Otherworldly Front-Runner does it again! Silence Suzuka takes first place!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: She's the best runner of her generation! Maybe even in all of racing history!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Trainer… I-I did it! I made it into the lead!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I saw it… I saw the scenery from the lead of the autumn Tenno Sho!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I could hear everyone's heartbeats, then I pushed past them all… And waiting for me there was…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: The most serene and beautiful scenery I've seen in a race yet!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad I ran today! Thank goodness I was able to!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Thank you… I knew I would be able to find my way back to you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so ends the autumn Tenno Sho. The cheers from the audience ring out for quite some time.
